description:
This Resort is close to Nashville’s best music, liquor, and historical landmarks.
Located just one mile from the Grand Ole Opry, Club Wyndham Nashville provides a great base to explore all the middle Tennessee has to offer. Conveniently located near destinations like the Country Music Hall of Fame and the Nashville Zoo, you can easily explore all that Nashville has to offer. Plus, take a scenic drive out to the Jack Daniel’s Distillery or explore the shops and restaurants of Green Hills.
